<!--
  The top of a page: heading, lead and actions, with optional media (image, backdrop, code window, cluster).
  Axes: layout, media kind and side, scale, tone, density, actions mode.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { HeroMedia } from "./hero-classic.types";
  import type { ActionSet } from "../components/cta-actions.types";
  import type { CodeLine } from "../components/code-window.types";
  import type { Topic } from "../components/topic-chips.types";

  export type HeroClassicProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    text: string;
    level?: 1 | 2;
    badge?: string;
    topics?: Topic[];
    actions?: ActionSet;
    media?: HeroMedia;
    layout?: "centered" | "split";
    scale?: "default" | "display";
    tone?: "default" | "muted" | "inverse";
    density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Input from "../primitives/input/input.svelte";
  import Label from "../primitives/label/label.svelte";
  import ActionGroup from "../components/action-group.svelte";
  import Backdrop from "../components/backdrop.svelte";
  import CodeWindow from "../components/code-window.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import TopicChips from "../components/topic-chips.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    text,
    level = 1,
    badge,
    topics,
    actions,
    media,
    layout = "centered",
    scale = "default",
    tone = "default",
    density = "roomy",
  }: HeroClassicProps = $props();
  const mediaKind = $derived(media?.kind ?? "none");
  const mediaSide = $derived(media?.side ?? "end");
</script>

<Backdrop kind={(((mediaKind as string) === "backdrop") ? "image" : "none")} alt={title}>
  <SectionFrame
    id={id}
    title={title}
    lead={text}
    heading={{ level, scale, badge }}
    layout={(((layout as string) === "split") ? "split" : "stack")}
    align={(((layout as string) === "split") ? "start" : "center")}
    media={{
      show: (((mediaKind as string) === "image") || ((mediaKind as string) === "code") || ((mediaKind as string) === "cluster")),
      side: mediaSide,
    }}
    tone={tone}
    density={density}
  >
    {#if actions?.cta}
      {#if (actions?.mode === "form")}
        <Box
          class={cn("w-full max-w-xl", (((layout as string) === "centered") ? "mx-auto" : ""))}
          data-testid="email-form"
        >
          <Label for={tpl("{0}-email", id)} class="sr-only">
            {actions?.emailLabel}
          </Label>
          <Group gap="2" align="start" class="w-full flex-wrap">
            <Input
              type="text"
              name="prompt"
              class="min-w-0 flex-1"
              placeholder={actions?.emailLabel}
              id={tpl("{0}-email", id)}
              data-testid="field"
            />
            <Button variant="default" size="default" href={(actions?.href ?? "#/")} data-testid="submit">
              {actions?.cta}
            </Button>
          </Group>
        </Box>
      {:else}
        <ActionGroup
          primary={actions?.cta}
          primaryHref={actions?.href}
          secondary={((actions?.mode === "two") ? actions?.secondary : undefined)}
          secondaryHref={actions?.secondaryHref}
          align={(((layout as string) === "centered") ? "center" : "start")}
        />
      {/if}
    {/if}
    {#if topics}
      <TopicChips topics={topics} />
    {/if}
    {#snippet aside()}
      {#if (((mediaKind as string) === "code") && media?.lines && media?.codeTitle && media?.prompt)}
        <CodeWindow title={media?.codeTitle} prompt={media?.prompt} lines={media?.lines} />
      {/if}
      {#if ((mediaKind as string) === "cluster")}
        <Grid cols="3" class="items-end gap-4" data-testid="cluster">
          <Box class={cn("w-full", "")}>
            <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio="3/4" />
          </Box>
          <Box class={cn("w-full", "-translate-y-4")}>
            <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio="4/3" />
          </Box>
          <Box class={cn("w-full", "")}>
            <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio="3/4" />
          </Box>
        </Grid>
      {/if}
      {#if (((mediaKind as string) === "image"))}
        <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio="4/3" />
      {/if}
    {/snippet}
  </SectionFrame>
</Backdrop>
